clue.text: Growth in tropics doubling share of profits

indicators.note: doubling tells us to write the piece for the share of profits twice over

parts.note: a divi is an informal British word for a dividend, a share of a company's profits

explanation.surface: Tropical growth that keeps doubling a shareholder's dividend.
explanation.definitionFit: The divi-divi is a tropical American tree, so it is a plant growing in the tropics.

clue.text: Charge one penny for boost

parts.note: to charge a container is to fill it
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Asking a single penny as a little incentive.
explanation.definitionFit: A fillip is a stimulus or small encouragement, a synonym for a boost.

clue.text: Strange bird is in Mediterranean port

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters that follow are made odd, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An unusual bird has turned up in a southern European harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' is the anagram signal; the word 'in' is part of the fodder here, not a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Brindisi is a seaport in southern Italy on the Adriatic, part of the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Member repeatedly giving encouragement to cheer

indicators.note: repeatedly asks for the limb's word to be given more than once, here twice

parts.note: a member is a limb or body part, such as the hip

explanation.surface: A club member keeps urging the crowd to cheer.
explanation.definitionFit: The call that leads a crowd into a hurrah is a prompt urging people to cheer.

clue.text: Eg gin bottle

definitions.meaning: gin is an example of a distilled alcoholic drink
bottle is British slang for courage or nerve

explanation.definitionFit: Gin is a type of distilled drink, and courage or mettle is another sense of the word.

clue.text: Penetrate mind of son in family

parts.note: taken as written
kin means family or relatives

explanation.surface: A family's thinking is seeping into their son's mind.
explanation.definitionFit: When an idea finally sinks in, it is absorbed and understood, getting into the mind.

clue.text: Great actor one found in Berlin family

definitions.meaning: Sir Henry ... was a celebrated Victorian stage actor
the songwriter ... Berlin bore this first name, so it is a member of the Berlin family

explanation.definitionFit: Henry Irving was a famous English stage actor, and the composer Irving Berlin shares the name.

clue.text: Sudden malfunction, hence good fruit is incomplete

indicators.note: is incomplete tells us the fruit's word loses its final letter

parts.note: litchi is a variant spelling of lychee, a Chinese fruit

explanation.surface: A machine fault means the good fruit never got finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is incomplete' drops the last I of LITCHI, leaving LITCH; 'hence' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A glitch is a brief unexpected fault in a machine or system.

clue.text: Damaged garments that disrupt working day

definitions.meaning: torn shirts or dresses read literally as shifts that have split
work rotas divided into two periods with a long break between them

explanation.definitionFit: A shift is a dress and a split one is damaged; split shifts are also broken-up working hours.

clue.text: Block up home? Fine, I will

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
I'll is the contraction of I will

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to fill in a gap at their house.
explanation.definitionFit: To infill is to fill up a gap or hole, as in blocking up an opening in a wall.

clue.text: Attach note about husband being substitute for striker

parts.note: to pin something is to attach it

indicators.note: about says the short note wraps around the letter for husband

parts.note: a chit is a short note or voucher

explanation.surface: Someone pins a note about a spouse who is replacing a footballer.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball a pinch-hitter bats in place of another player, so to pinch-hit is to substitute for a batter.

clue.text: Person found down under bird

definitions.meaning: a New Zealander, from a country in the Antipodes

explanation.definitionFit: Kiwi is informal for a New Zealander and also the name of a flightless bird.

clue.text: Conservative in battle's making bitter speeches

indicators.note: in says the letter for Conservative goes inside the battle's name

parts.note: Philippi was the site of the battle of 42 BC where Brutus and Cassius were defeated; the 's adds S

explanation.surface: A Tory in the thick of a fight is making bitter speeches.
explanation.definitionFit: Philippics are fierce denunciations, named after Demosthenes' speeches attacking Philip of Macedon.

clue.text: Miss completely part of the US

definitions.meaning: Miss. is the postal abbreviation of a US state, so written out in full it gives that state's name
a state in the southern United States

explanation.definitionFit: Mississippi is a US state whose standard abbreviation is Miss., so spelling Miss out completely gives it.

clue.text: If put in second gear in Highlands, they'll take people up mountains

indicators.note: put in tells us the letters of If are placed inside the Highland garments

parts.note: kilts are traditional Scottish Highland clothing

explanation.surface: Advice about changing into second gear while driving in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gear' looks like a car's gearbox but means clothing; KILTS are the pleated skirts worn in the Scottish Highlands.
explanation.definitionFit: Ski lifts are cable systems that carry skiers up mountain slopes.

clue.text: Photograph college to make money

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a photograph
King's is a college of Cambridge University (and of London)

explanation.surface: Taking pictures at a university to earn some cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickings are profits or gains, often easily obtained money.

clue.text: Material for writing in depth with something similar

parts.note: ink is the fluid used for writing
taken as written

explanation.surface: Writing materials described in depth alongside comparable items.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying in kind means giving goods or something similar rather than money.

clue.text: Not a good shot of him — it's distorted

indicators.note: distorted says the letters are twisted out of shape into a new order

explanation.surface: A badly framed photograph of a man, which is out of shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' suggests a photograph but means a stroke in a game; 'distorted' rearranges HIM and ITS.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishit is a poorly struck ball in a sport such as cricket or golf.

clue.text: Carving section of twins' crib ingeniously

indicators.note: section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A craftsman cleverly carves part of a cot made for twins.
explanation.definitionFit: Inscribing means cutting letters or designs into a surface, as in carving.

clue.text: Judge of performance, mostly a pain in the neck about it

indicators.note: about says the shortened neck pain goes around the word it
mostly means most of the word is used, so its final letter goes

parts.note: a crick is a painful stiffness in the neck

explanation.surface: A reviewer who is mostly an irritation in regard to a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a pain in the neck' reads as an annoying person but is meant literally; 'mostly' drops the final K, and 'about' wraps the shortened word around the clue's 'it'.
explanation.definitionFit: A critic assesses and reviews performances such as plays or concerts.

clue.text: Taunting Crosby in the army?

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier, a man in the army
Bing Crosby was the American crooner

explanation.surface: Wondering whether the singer Crosby was mocked while serving as a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Gibing means jeering or mocking someone, so it is a synonym for taunting.

clue.text: Use iron for part of computer

definitions.meaning: in golf a short lofted shot is often played with an iron club
a silicon microchip inside a computer

explanation.definitionFit: A golfer plays a short lofted stroke with an iron, and a computer processor is a silicon component.

clue.text: As a rule, nothing would suit him better

definitions.text: As a rule, nothing would suit him better

parts.words: As a rule, nothing would suit him better
parts.note: an idiom read literally: a rule of nothing, a creed that believes in no values at all, is what this person prefers

explanation.surface: A fussy person who is usually content with whatever is offered.
explanation.definitionFit: A nihilist rejects all moral principles and beliefs, so taking nothing as a rule describes them.

clue.text: Destroy British land

parts.note: to light is to alight or land, as a bird does

explanation.surface: An order to lay waste to the territory of Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: To blight is to spoil or ruin something, as a disease withers crops.

clue.text: At sea, is powerless to move imports

definitions.text: At sea, is powerless to move
definitions.meaning: a boat without power floats wherever the currents carry it
imports as a noun means meanings or general senses, as in the gist of an argument

explanation.definitionFit: A powerless vessel moves aimlessly with the current, and the gist or meaning of a speech is another sense.

clue.text: Man who may be white, despite what we hear

definitions.text: Man who may be white, despite what we hear

parts.words: Man who may be white, despite what we hear
parts.note: a chess piece can be one of the white set, though its spoken name sounds like the dark time of day

explanation.definitionFit: A knight is a chess piece, and chessmen are either white or black.
